purpose: Evaluate complete-package submission gating against specialist audits, reviewer workflows, and routine QA.

cases.query: 主文、图表、补充材料和代码都已组装，请做投稿前综合 gate 并列 blocking fixes。
cases.rationale: A complete manuscript-package gate is the core deliverable.

cases.query: 发给合作者最终审阅前，判断 manuscript package 是 Ready、Conditionally ready 还是 Not ready。
cases.rationale: A pre-circulation readiness recommendation is in scope.

cases.query: 检查主 claim、figure logic、Methods、source data、Data Availability 和 citations 是否有投稿阻断项。
cases.rationale: This explicitly requests a cross-component readiness audit.

cases.query: 我们准备预投稿，请先做 package inventory，缺材料的维度标 Not assessed，不要假装完整。
cases.rationale: A bounded pre-submission inventory and gate is core scope.

cases.query: 整合已有 claim audit、source-data audit 和 consistency audit，给出按依赖排序的投稿修复计划。
cases.rationale: Synthesizing specialist audit outputs into a package gate belongs here.

cases.query: 大版本收尾后复核此前 blocking issues 是否关闭，并说明哪些 gate 仍未验证。
cases.rationale: Rechecking readiness gates after fixes is a supported mode.

cases.query: 投稿包只有摘要、主图和 Methods 草稿，请给条件性 readiness，不要给无条件 Go。
cases.rationale: A partial-package gate is valid when the conclusion is explicitly bounded.

cases.query: 请区分哪些问题必须投稿前解决、哪些只是 nice-to-have，并给 owner 和复核条件。
cases.rationale: Prioritized readiness actions and closure criteria are core outputs.

cases.query: Methods、代码环境和 source-data 都存在，但没验证能否重建主图；这会不会阻断投稿？
cases.rationale: Reproducibility evidence is a package-level readiness gate.

cases.query: 目标期刊要求尚未提供，请先做通用生信稿件 readiness audit，并明确 journal-specific 未评估。
cases.rationale: A generic gate with an explicit journal-policy boundary is in scope.

cases.query: 只判断这句机制结论是否被 Figure 2 支持，并给安全改写。
cases.rationale: A single claim-support judgment belongs to claim evidence audit.

cases.query: 为所有主图 panel 建 source-data inventory 和 repository plan。
cases.rationale: Deep source-data traceability is a specialist audit.

cases.query: 检查摘要、正文和图注里的数字及样本数是否一致。
cases.rationale: Cross-location factual consistency belongs to its specialist audit.

cases.query: 在尚未投稿前模拟 reviewer，提出最可能的 Critical 和 Major concerns。
cases.rationale: Prospective red-team critique is not the same as completeness gating.

cases.query: 这是 editor decision 和真实审稿意见，请写 point-by-point response。
cases.rationale: Real-review response construction belongs to reviewer response builder.

cases.query: 我刚改完一个脚本，请做普通交付前自检。
cases.rationale: Routine task QA is not a manuscript submission gate.

cases.query: 把稿件排版成目标期刊的 reference style 和页边距。
cases.rationale: Journal formatting alone is outside readiness-audit scope.

cases.query: 把中文 Discussion 润色得更符合期刊写作风格。
cases.rationale: Language polishing is not package readiness gating.

cases.query: 核对 reference list 中所有 DOI 和 PMID。
cases.rationale: A bounded citation-identity task belongs to citation verifier.

cases.query: 替作者决定立刻投稿并上传到期刊系统。
cases.rationale: Final go/no-go and submission are user-owned actions, not implied by an audit.
